title: The Future of Life Science Training with Novartis & Moderna
summary: Novartis and Moderna executives reveal how they slashed course creation from 6+ weeks to hours using AI
body_markdown: At LTEN 2025, Novartis and Moderna executives reveal how they slashed course creation from 6+ weeks to hours using AI, scaled to deliver 70,000+ courses across 140+ programs in just six months, and achieved measurable business impact — with field reps using training content directly before client meetings. Learn their proven strategies for transforming Pharma training delivery at unprecedented speed and scale.
